Use negative Y speed and frame4; flip facing at count4, then at8 choose lateral movement or landing based on parameter sign. units.name: UpdateSoundVolumeEnvelope

units.name: WriteSoundVoiceToApu
units.summary: Skip APU output when an earlier logical voice claimed this hardware channel. Apply attenuation if marked, then write volume/control and period; period-high writes occur only when refresh/key-on flags demand them. Triangle omits the sweep/control register used by other channels.
units.review_credit: Pass006 physical encoding/range unchanged; prior review retained. Expanded dependent tables/actors and source locations reconciled in round3.

units.name: AttenuateSoundVoice

units.review_credit: Pass006 physical encoding/range unchanged; prior review retained. Expanded dependent tables/actors and source locations reconciled in round3.

regions.summary: Consume records from the alternate stack at QueueStackPointer. Each record supplies PPUCTRL bits, destination high/low, byte count and payload; a negative header ends the queue. Palette writes reset the PPU address latch through $3F00. Restore the caller stack before returning. Requires physical bank 14 at C000. Combine the record increment-mode bits with requested PPUCTRL, then stream the payload to PPUDATA. Queue A=destination high, X=destination low, Y=payload length and Scratch32 bits. Carry set uses pointer $30/$31. Carry clear consumes an inline little-endian source word after JSR and advances the saved return by two. Bytes are pushed backward so the consumer pulls them forward. Preserve the caller stack; scratch $33..$38 is overwritten.

regions.summary: Read controller1 until two consecutive serial samples agree. Bits from either low input line count as pressed. Suppress opposing directions, return new presses in ControllerPressed and held state in ControllerHeld. No runtime controller behavior is claimed. Advance the two-byte XOR/rotate generator in RandomLow/RandomHigh; return RandomLow. Called during frame waits, so timing affects the sequence. Select mapper register X and write A; retain A/X and save the selector. PRG registers 9..11 use value&15 as physical 8KiB index. This helper does not update requested bank shadows; callers do so separately. Set the pending-frame bit and advance the random word until NMI clears it. Then clear the PPU increment-by-32 bit in RequestedPpuControl. Requires functioning interrupts; this is a static wait contract. Read a backward metasprite record through SpriteDefinition: leading byte is the end offset, followed by four-byte sprite entries and an optional CHR value. Add screen coordinates, apply attributes/tile bits, clip offscreen sprites and emit OAM entries within the frame budget. Horizontal flip negates the relative X offset minus eight. Record role is established; individual sprite artwork meanings remain unresolved. Raise the brightness ceiling every four NMI updates: colors begin with their low luminance nibble and progressively regain source brightness. Finish when the signed step overflows. Scratch $10/$11 are fade step and delay. Lower the brightness ceiling every four NMI updates, then select the default palette. This darkens colors before restoring the default selection. A supplies brightness clamp, X supplies a shifting mask for universal-color entries. Copy the source palette to the transfer palette, replacing high brightness bits where needed; preserve every fourth entry unless its mask bit is set. Queue 32 bytes at PPU $3F00.
